title: ThomsonFly 757 bird strike & flames captured on video
summary: Amateur footage of a Thomsonfly 757 ingesting a bird on takeoff from Manchester, with a flaming engine and a safe return, with 233 people aboard.
why: HN links it as a vivid example of a bird strike taking out an engine, and praises the calm crew and ATC response.

quote.text: the response of the ATC within 1 second of the mayday call is plain amazing
